bosses.name: Jian Li
bosses.appearance: He is a lean, weathered figure, clad in simple, sand-colored robes that conceal a keen blade. His eyes, though often downcast, miss nothing, reflecting the harsh glint of the desert sun. A traditional Chinese broadsword, wrapped in aged leather, rests securely on his back, a silent testament to his origin.
bosses.surface_identity: The Silent Guardian of the Sunken Sands. He is initially encountered as a stoic, solitary figure protecting a hidden oasis or ancient ruins, offering cryptic warnings about the desert's dangers and occasionally aiding lost travelers. He seems to be a protector, albeit a mysterious one, devoted to preserving the delicate balance of this harsh land.
bosses.true_identity: The Obsessed Exile, Weaver of Sand Traps. His true identity is that of a powerful swordsman exiled from his homeland due to a tragic failure, who now meticulously manipulates the desert's treacherous environment and any who enter it. He orchestrates events to acquire ancient desert magic or artifacts, believing them to be the key to undoing his past and exacting vengeance on those who scorned him or who he blames for his banishment. He sees the expedition not as allies, but as pawns.
bosses.motivation: Driven by an unyielding obsession to reverse a past failure and regain his lost honor, Jian Li seeks the legendary 'Heart of the Desert,' an ancient power rumored to control time and destiny. He believes this power will allow him to rewrite history, preventing the tragedy that banished him, and unleash his silent, burning revenge upon those he deems responsible, even if it means sacrificing countless lives in the process.
bosses.twist: Foolish wanderers. You did well to lead me here, but your journey ends. This power... it was never meant for your salvation, but for my retribution. Now, witness the true strength of an exile scorned!
